description: Order-lifecycle trigger layer + preference actions: emit Inngest notification events from the payment verify route, the Razorpay webhook, the COD place-order action, the admin refund action, and a new admin updateOrderStatus action (the main trigger for shipped/delivered/cancelled). Also add the user notification-preference server actions. Every inngest.send() is wrapped in try/catch so a notification failure never breaks the order/payment flow. The order.cancelled emit carries the fact that stock was restored.
steps: Create lib/validations/notifications.ts with two Zod schemas + inferred types: (a) updateNotificationPreferencesSchema = z.object({ email: z.boolean(), sms: z.boolean(), whatsapp: z.boolean() }); (b) updateOrderStatusSchema = z.object({ orderId: z.string().uuid(), status: z.enum(['shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled']) }). Export the inferred types. Follow the pattern in lib/validations/checkout.ts.

Modify app/api/payments/verify/route.ts: after a successful kind 'success' transaction result, before returning the 200 response, fetch the order's userId (select userId from orders where id = orderId), then await inngest.send({ name: 'notification/order.confirmed', data: { userId, orderId } }) wrapped in try/catch (log on error, never throw). Do NOT emit for the 'alreadyVerified' path (idempotent). Import the inngest client from '@/lib/inngest/client'. Keep all existing logic and comments intact.

Modify app/api/payments/webhook/route.ts: after each handler's transaction commits, emit the matching event (all wrapped in try/catch, log on error, never throw — these run after the DB transaction so a notification failure cannot roll back or break the 200 response): (a) handlePaymentCaptured -> fetch userId and inngest.send({ name: 'notification/order.confirmed', data: { userId, orderId } }); (b) handlePaymentFailed -> fetch userId and inngest.send({ name: 'notification/order.cancelled', data: { userId, orderId, stockRestored: true } }); (c) handleRefundProcessed -> fetch userId and the payment amount and inngest.send({ name: 'notification/refund.processed', data: { userId, orderId, amount } }). Each emit must be OUTSIDE its db.transaction() callback (transactions cannot await external HTTP). Import the inngest client. Keep all existing handlers, idempotency checks, and signature verification intact.

Modify actions/checkout.ts placeCodOrder: after the transaction commits and the cart is cleared, before the final revalidatePath/return, await inngest.send({ name: 'notification/order.confirmed', data: { userId, orderId: order.id } }) wrapped in try/catch (log on error). userId and order.id are already in scope. Import the inngest client from '@/lib/inngest/client'. Do not change the existing transaction or COD logic.

Modify actions/admin.ts processRefund: after the refund transaction commits and before revalidatePath/return, await inngest.send({ name: 'notification/refund.processed', data: { userId: order.userId, orderId, amount: String(payment.amount) } }) wrapped in try/catch (log on error). order and payment are in scope. Import the inngest client.

Add to actions/admin.ts a new exported server action updateOrderStatus(orderId: string, status: 'shipped'|'delivered'|'cancelled'): Promise<ApiResponse<{ orderId: string; status: string }>>. Gate with await requireAdmin(). Zod-parse with updateOrderStatusSchema (import from '@/lib/validations/notifications'); return err on failure. Load the order; if not found return err('Order not found'). If status === 'cancelled', run a db.transaction that sets the order status to 'cancelled', restores stock (increment each order_item's variant stock, mirroring the webhook handlePaymentFailed pattern — use Drizzle's sql tagged template sql followed by a template literal that adds item.quantity to productVariants.stock), and rolls back coupon usage if a coupon was used (mirror processRefund's coupon cleanup). For 'shipped'/'delivered', simply update the order status (no stock change). After the transaction, emit the matching notification event wrapped in try/catch: shipped -> inngest.send({ name: 'notification/order.shipped', data: { userId: order.userId, orderId } }); delivered -> 'notification/order.delivered'; cancelled -> 'notification/order.cancelled' with data { userId: order.userId, orderId, stockRestored: true }. Then revalidatePath('/admin/orders') and return ok({ orderId, status }). Import eq, sql from drizzle-orm; orders, orderItems, productVariants, coupons, userCouponUsage from '@/db/schema'.

Create actions/notifications.ts (top line "use server"): import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm'; { db } from '@/db'; { profiles } from '@/db/schema'; { requireAuth } from '@/lib/auth'; { ok, err, type ApiResponse } from '@/lib/api-response'; { updateNotificationPreferencesSchema } from '@/lib/validations/notifications'. (a) getNotificationPreferences(): Promise<ApiResponse<{ email: boolean; sms: boolean; whatsapp: boolean }>> -> const user = await requireAuth(); select the profile by user.id; if not found return err('Profile not found'); return ok({ email: profile.emailNotifications, sms: profile.smsNotifications, whatsapp: profile.whatsappNotifications }). (b) updateNotificationPreferences(input): Promise<ApiResponse<{ email: boolean; sms: boolean; whatsapp: boolean }>> -> const user = await requireAuth(); Zod-parse input; on failure return err('Invalid input', fieldErrors); update the profiles row setting emailNotifications/smsNotifications/whatsappNotifications and updatedAt = new Date(); return ok with the new values.
acceptance_criteria: lib/validations/notifications.ts exports updateNotificationPreferencesSchema and updateOrderStatusSchema with inferred types.
app/api/payments/verify/route.ts emits notification/order.confirmed { userId, orderId } after a successful capture (not on alreadyVerified), wrapped in try/catch.

app/api/payments/webhook/route.ts emits order.confirmed, order.cancelled (stockRestored:true), and refund.processed (with amount) after the respective handlers' transactions, each outside the transaction and wrapped in try/catch.
actions/checkout.ts placeCodOrder emits notification/order.confirmed { userId, orderId } after order creation, wrapped in try/catch.
actions/admin.ts processRefund emits notification/refund.processed { userId, orderId, amount } after the refund transaction, wrapped in try/catch.
actions/admin.ts exports updateOrderStatus(orderId, status) gated by requireAdmin, Zod-validated, restoring stock for 'cancelled', emitting the matching notification event.
actions/notifications.ts exports getNotificationPreferences and updateNotificationPreferences as 'use server' actions using requireAuth and the profiles opt-in columns.
npm run build completes with zero TypeScript errors; existing verification/webhook/checkout/refund logic and idempotency are unchanged in behavior.
npm run test passes all existing tests.
verification: Run npm run build and confirm zero TypeScript/compiler errors (validates the new inngest.send() call sites and the new updateOrderStatus action compile and integrate with FEAT-001/FEAT-002 imports).
Run npm run test and confirm all existing tests (cart.service.guest.test.ts, lib/validations/checkout.test.ts, lib/validations/cart.test.ts) still pass.
